concepts.name: Pčelicin medeni dan
concepts.prompt: Create ONE finished invitation BACKGROUND ONLY, vertical EXACT 5:7 aspect ratio, ideally 1500x2100 pixels. Full bleed flat artwork, no paper mockup, no surface, no hands, no perspective of the invitation, no external shadow. NO TEXT whatsoever: no letters, numerals, age, logos or watermark. Keep ALL important subjects and decorative focal details at least 7% inward from every trim edge; only plain color and expendable minor foliage may bleed. Beautiful detailed polished commercial illustration, intentional restrained composition with a LARGE coherent clear area for LARGE editable typography to be added later. Not a collage, not multiple variants. First birthday for a little girl: joyful sophisticated gouache children's illustration, honey yellow and rich coral with turquoise accents, soft warm ivory central field. Two charming small fluffy honeybees with correct delicate wings, daisy and poppy meadow clusters concentrated at lower left and upper right, a few subtle rounded honeycomb cells near the bottom. Keep bees fully intact inside safe margins. Fresh lively palette, no washed-out beige filter, no giant white rectangle, no generic full floral frame. Center from x25%-80%, y14%-80% mostly quiet. Airy crafted shapes, not toy-like 3D.
